items: Each sleeping legend's circle now has a happy baby of its own kind in it, which stays inside the circle; only on your leash does it follow you
A siege can knock that baby down: with none of its kind left in the area, the legend grows restless, then angry
The circle's edge is framed by thicker, taller undergrowth, with short sparse tufts on its floor, and its edge is ragged rather than a clean cut
